Create OR ALTER view RPT.MONTHLY_SALES_kayal as
WITH MonthlySales AS (
    SELECT
        YEAR(OrderDate) AS order_year,
        MONTH(OrderDate) AS order_month,
        SUM(totalprice) AS total_sales
    FROM ODS.ORDERS_kayal
    GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate), MONTH(OrderDate)
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    order_month,
    total_sales,
    LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month) AS previous_month_sales,
    ((total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month)) / LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month)) * 100 AS sales_growth_percentage
FROM MonthlySales;
